bullets.text: In Chennai, a young man tragically died after losing control of his bike and falling into stagnant rainwater.
Cyclone Murasu has uprooted 12 trees and damaged properties across Chennai, causing severe waterlogging and traffic disruptions.
In Thiruvallur and Chennai, Cyclone Murasu has triggered heavy rainfall alerts and disrupted express train services.
In Velachery, plastic waste and sewage have accumulated in the Pelli Amman temple tank in Taramani, causing a foul smell.
In Pallikaranai, heavy traffic congestion occurred near Kamatchi Hospital on the radial road due to light rain and peak hours.
In Uthukottai, a 26-year-old motorcyclist died after being hit by a lorry near Polivakkam.
In Gummidipoondi, sewage vehicle owners staged a protest by parking their vehicles inside the block development office campus.
In Tiruvallur, liquor sales and bars within 5 km of the Andhra Pradesh border have been barred ahead of the Chittoor polls.
Vultr plans to build 1 GW of AI compute capacity in India by 2029, placing Chennai at the center of this expansion.
MeitY has unveiled the DEPA framework handbook to help institutions securely share data for AI training purposes.
Data centers driven by AI growth are increasing rapidly in Tamil Nadu, with Chennai seeing significant development and rising capacity.
